title: Ops
audience: For the Ops role (Kajal's): what each kind of change sends to clients, the call centre and support, and what ops does before, on the day and after.

sections.heading: What each kind of change sets in motion
lines: One row per kind of change. Counts are per 1,000 clients; N means no example gives the figure.
How a change reaches plans is a proposed default. Pushed now, it refreshes every plan it picks. Clients get a message only for an update to accept or an urgent one.

Update sizes: tiny changes nothing for the client. Picture moved changes no instalment, but moves how far a goal is funded, or a goal's mix; it asks for nothing. To accept changes an instalment or the risk level; the client must accept. Urgent is an urgent hold on a fund the client has a SIP into, or an exit from a fund in their verified holdings.
Batches (LQ14): an urgent hold and a fix go to everyone at once; a routine hold, 200 clients an hour, 10:00 to 18:00 IST; an exit, even daily batches over five working days.
Pushed now, an update to accept gets a push notification when ready, then reminders (S11): a push notification on day 3 (N-S11-3d on the board). Reminders make no call tasks.
Listed under What is new on the ops side: the urgent reminders (a push notification and WhatsApp at once, an email the next morning) and the wording of every message and update screen.
Screens L and V are on the Logic tab; stories Y01 to Y04, on the Walkthroughs page.
Calls made while building (logic plan, 8 Oct 2026), open to veto: urgent hold wording and call centre script ready ahead.

sections.heading: Before a change goes out
lines: Before a change goes out, ops runs down its list. If something is missing, note it in the box below and we look at it together.
Each list holds only the checks it needs: nothing is pushed for a change that waits for the next refresh, and an urgent hold or a fix goes at once, with no day to choose.
Market readings, safety limits and settings on M10 send nothing to clients, and how a new plan engine version reaches plans is open (LQ46). So none of them has a list.
Calls made while building (logic plan, 8 Oct 2026), open to veto: each list holds only the checks it needs.

lines: In all, a change like REL12 is tiny for 330 clients, picture moved for 540 and to accept for 130.
Left to each plan's next refresh, about 60 plans a week take it up. A picture-moved update asks for nothing, so no one chases it.
Typed from a rough run over made-up people and from assumptions: a plausible picture, not evidence. Nothing here is computed.

sections.heading: The email
lines: One email for each house-view change that alters what clients see. It says what changed and why, and that the client's plan takes it up at their next review, with the date (V05).
Its wording is still to come, listed with the other message wording below.
Ops queues it in {I14}. When the Principal officer sends the change, Send (L06) shows whether the email is queued.
When it goes is open (LQ33). In the example year, the email for REL12 went out on 1 Apr 2028 at 09:00, queued by ops (Y01).

sections.heading: The unknown funds list (L04b)
lines: Some holdings on a client's statement carry an ISIN the fund master list ({I05}) does not know. Each waits on the list with its ISIN, the name on the statement, its holders, the facts ops added and the proposed class.
Home (L01) shows ops the items that need facts.

In the example year two items waited: one worth Rs 80,000, bought Mar 2024, and one worth Rs 50,000, bought Aug 2023. Change REL03 gave them a class on 16 Jun 2027: one known and not approved, one legacy hold.

lines: Role changes are made on Staff and roles (L13). The allowed-staff list sits on M03, as decided on 7 Oct 2026; where it lives is open (LQ9).
There are ten fixed roles; staff cannot make new ones. One person may hold more than one. The Access page shows what each role may do.
Each role change (add, change, suspend, remove) asks for a fresh security check and leaves a line in the log.

The access check, each quarter: the Principal officer goes through every staff member on L13 and keeps, changes or removes them. For each: roles, status (active, suspended, revoked), who added them and when, last sign-in, and whether two-step sign-in is on.
In the example year, access check 1 on 15 Jul 2027 suspended Adviser 06, idle 90 days. Logic analyst 02 was added on 4 Oct 2027, signed by Compliance, and revoked on 27 Oct 2027.
If a role looks wrong, note it in the box below and we look at it together.
Calls made while building (logic plan, 8 Oct 2026), open to veto: role requests go to the Principal officer.
